result.title: DSADiff: Data Structure-Aware Diffusion for Crystal Structure Prediction via Mitigating Complexity- and Imbalance-Induced Biases
result.summary: Crystal Structure Prediction (CSP) is an important step in accelerating the generation and discovery of new materials. In recent years, diffusion-based CSP methods have made significant progress. However, existing models still suffer from generation bias when facing diverse materials spaces, while systematic approaches for tracing the sources of such performance variations remain limited. To address this issue, we propose LAS (Layered Analysis Strategy), a mechanism analysis framework that identifies crystal complexity and elemental composition imbalance as two key factors affecting generation difficulty and further reveals their relationships with model generation performance. Building on these findings, we further propose DSADiff (Data Structure-Aware Diffusion), a data structure-aware diffusion model that transforms the key factors identified by LAS into a unified generation difficulty representation and uses it to jointly drive feature modeling and training strategy optimization. This enables the model to adapt its representation and generation capability to samples with different data structures and difficulty levels, thereby mitigating learning bias across samples. Experiments on three CSP benchmark datasets, including Carbon-24, demonstrate that DSADiff consistently improves both Match Rate and RMSE, with a maximum Match Rate improvement of 9%, surpassing existing state-of-the-art methods and achieving new state-of-the-art performance. This work deepens the understanding of diffusion-based CSP models from the perspective of generation bias and provides a new direction for designing less biased generative models for complex materials spaces.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究扩散模型用于晶体结构预测时的生成偏差问题：提出 LAS 分层分析框架，将晶体复杂度与元素组成不平衡识别为影响生成难度的两个关键因素，并据此提出 DSADiff，把二者统一为「生成难度表示」以联合驱动特征建模与训练策略优化，在 Carbon-24 等三个基准上提升 Match Rate 与 RMSE。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「复杂度/不平衡→统一难度表示→条件化控制表示与训练」的思路，可能可供核查用于按任务难度调节 latent 推理的计算与监督强度，以及对生成偏差来源做机制性拆解；但领域为材料生成，与视觉推理无直接联系，属较远启发线索。
